subject: general
question: Which of the following works was written by Bernardin Evaristo?

options.text: 10 Minutes 38 Seconds in This Strange World)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Girl, Woman, Other.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bernardine Evaristo is the writer of the novel Girl, Woman, Other.
 
• She is a British Writer.
 
• In 2019 Margaret Atwood(The Testament) and Bernardine Evaristo(Girl, Woman, and Other) won Manbooker Prize.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lucy Ellmann**, author of **Ducks, Newburyport **has won The James Tait Black award for the novel.
 
• **10 Minutes 38 Seconds in This Strange World** has been authored by Elif Shafak.
 
• **An Orchestra of Minorities **is a 2019 novel by** Chigozie Obioma. **
